items.title: Walmart (WMT) Launches Florida Drone Delivery And GLP 1 Weight Loss Prescriptions
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) is rolling out drone delivery in parts of Florida through a partnership with Alphabet owned Wing. The company is also expanding into GLP-1 weight loss drug prescriptions, paired with nutrition coaching and AI based support services. Both moves come as competition with other large retailers intensifies around delivery speed and direct to consumer healthcare offerings.
